items.title: Apple stock falls on weak revenue forecast as CEO Tim Cook flags 'increasing impact' from memory shortage
items.summary: The iPhone maker reported its third quarter earnings on Thursday, beating analysts' expectations on the top and bottom lines on strong iPhone sales, but shares fell after Services and Greater China sales came up short.

items.title: Listen to Tim Cook's first and last earnings calls as Apple CEO
items.summary: Tim Cook has left a lasting legacy at Apple (AAPL), from his first earnings call as CEO in 2011 to his last one in 2026. Cook will step down as CEO on September 1, 2026 passing the baton to John Ternus, Apple's Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering.

items.title: Apple's iPhone leasing program: How it works, what to consider

items.title: AAPL Q2 Deep Dive: Supply Chain Strains and Product Demand Set Stage for Deceleration
items.summary: iPhone and iPad maker Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 16.4% year on year to $109.4 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.02 per share was 7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: South Korea exports beat forecasts in July on AI chip demand
items.summary: Investing.com -- South Korean exports grew faster than expected in July, supported by strong global demand for semiconductors and computers used in artificial intelligence infrastructure, preliminary trade data showed on Saturday.
